title: Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan Rental Tenure Uplift on Refunds of Credit Balances
content:
A refund of the credit balance left on an ended Bluegate Tenant Protection Plan carries a rental tenure uplift, read from the Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement the plan covered — its move-in date — measured to the date the plan ended. The uplift adds interest of the credit balance multiplied by the uplift and by the refund's late days, divided by 365.

## Uplift by rental tenure

| Whole months from the rental's move-in date to the date the plan ended | Tenure uplift (a year) |
| --- | --- |
| 60 or more | 0.02 |
| at least 24 and fewer than 60 | 0.01 |
| fewer than 24 | nothing |

Stated as a rule: the refund tenure uplift is 0.02 a year when the ended plan's rental had a move-in date 60 or more whole months before the plan ended, 0.01 when its move-in date was at least 24 and fewer than 60 whole months before the plan ended, and nothing otherwise.

## Boundary reading (hypothetical)

A rental 60 whole months from move-in when the plan ended takes 0.02; at 59 whole months it takes 0.01; at 24 whole months 0.01; at 23 whole months nothing. The measure stops at the date the plan ended, not the handling date.
